title: External Calls Before State Updates in deposit()
description: The deposit function calls `mainRewarder.stake()` before updating `clientBalances` and `totalDeposited` state variables. While the `nonReentrant` modifier prevents direct exploitation, this violates the checks-effects-interactions pattern.
impact: If mainRewarder has callback capability, it could observe inconsistent contract state. The nonReentrant modifier mitigates direct reentrancy, but the pattern is still suboptimal.
attackPath: mainRewarder.stake() is called before state updates
If mainRewarder has callbacks, it observes state where stake completed but balances not yet updated
nonReentrant prevents direct reentrancy but state inconsistency exists momentarily
codeSnippet: // mainRewarder.stake() called before updating clientBalances and totalDeposited
recommendation: Follow checks-effects-interactions pattern by updating state variables before making external calls to mainRewarder.
